name: Excalidraw 架构与建模画布
description: 在工作面板里用 Excalidraw 画技术架构图、业务建模图、流程图、时序图：四种图一键生成初稿，再手工拖改；场景可存成 .excalidraw 文件回读，也能导出 SVG。0.2.0 起与 Archify 插件联动：可把 Archify 的 architecture 候选 JSON 导入画布继续手改，也能直接打开 Archify 生成的 HTML 成品。

en.name: Excalidraw Studio
en.description: Draw technical architecture, domain-model, flowchart and sequence diagrams on an Excalidraw canvas inside the work panel. Four starters generate a first draft you can drag around; scenes save as .excalidraw files in diagrams/ and export to SVG. Since 0.2.0 it pairs with the Archify plugin: import an Archify architecture candidate JSON onto the canvas to hand-edit it, and open Archify's generated HTML straight from the toolbar.
en.safetyNotes: Reads and writes only inside the workspace: reads diagrams/** and *.excalidraw, writes diagrams/**. No network access at runtime (fonts and the Excalidraw bundle ship with the plugin). Your drawings stay on disk in the .excalidraw JSON format, which is plain text.
